integrity: The six published facet lists are reconstructed exactly. A standalone finite verifier checks manifold incidence and links, computes the mod-two chain ranks, exhausts every graph triangle, tests boundary membership exactly, and groups all shortest cycles by exact homology equivalence.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the six exact 12-vertex orientable equivelar triangulations of Euler characteristic -2 and to simple mod-two homology 1-cycles. No assertion is made about integral systoles, longer representatives, metric geodesics, or other triangulations.
title: Triangular mod-two systoles across the six equivelar double-tori
